description:
Three user-facing arguments are missing from the CLI help text and MCP docstrings:

1. driver_version - valid --platform-option key for all platforms, registered via
   _register_driver_version_options() in benchbox/cli/platform_defaults.py.
   Allows pinning the Python driver package to a specific version (e.g. '1.2.0').

2. driver_auto_install - valid --platform-option key for all platforms (same
   registration). When true, automatically installs the requested driver version
   via uv if missing.

3. engine_version - valid --platform-option key for Athena Spark specifically.
   Read at adapter construction from config.get("engine_version") in
   benchbox/platforms/aws/athena_spark_adapter.py:707. Selects the Spark engine
   version (default: "PySpark engine version 3"). For all other cloud platforms
   (Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse, Databricks, Firebolt, Trino, MotherDuck),
   engine_version is AUTO-PROBED via SQL queries - it is NOT user-settable on
   those platforms.

Currently the --platform-option advanced option is described only as "Platform
option in KEY=VALUE form (repeatable)" with no indication of what keys are
available. The MCP run_benchmark docstring similarly has no mention of driver or
engine version options.

Additionally, the existing help text should be audited for consistency with the
current code - option descriptions, examples, and the CLAUDE.md quick reference
table should all reflect the actual CLI and MCP behaviour.
